This wine opener is smaller and easier for me to use than the name brand that I have.  It has a nice feel enough weight so it still feels substantial.  It pulls corks very well.  I wish it came with additional screws.  The foil cutter takes a little dexterity and practice.  You have to get the wine bottle snugly up in the unit, hold the opener tightly on the wine bottle, and then I turn the bottle while squeezing the opener on the bottle.  I really like this wine opener especially because it is smaller and a little lighter than my old opener.
